verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents resource-level retention controls. Expiration policies can auto-delete sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions. Files can be deleted via the SDK, MCP server or REST API. Sandboxes can be archived and unarchived, and Volumes are explicitly persistent beyond sandbox destruction. These are lifecycle controls aimed mainly at cost and storage, not a privacy-oriented retention posture. Missing for 10: platform-level data retention policy, retention and deletion controls for logs, snapshots and execution history, account/tenant data deletion guarantees, and independent corroboration.
